body.x: QODE Interactive (CEO Kim Seong-eun, www.qode.kr) showcased its “4D IoT Smart Table”, a table which is controlled via a smartphone, in the joint pavilion of the Mobile Technology Convergence Center (MTCC) at the world’s best IT technology exhibition ‘CES(Consumer Technology Show) 2016’ which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas Convention Center(LVCC).

By using the company’s own “contactless moving of things” technology, the product enables users to move objects how they want to. If users play a game and control the markers on the table by using a smartphone, the markers will automatically move according to users’ commands.
The Smart Table A Series is a smart table that incorporates the company’s own technology. It can be used to understand and exchange the technology.

The Smart Table E Series is an interactive table for education. It provides stereoscopic educational games for children and elementary school students. Highly educational, it combines both augmented reality and IoT technologies.
The Drunken Shot Series tackles the food and entertainment industries simultaneously. It possesses the emotional elements of those who have dinner together via IoT.
QODE Interactive CEO Kim Seong-eun said: “We will keep showcasing IoT-based game platforms that can quench the extreme individualism of modern society.”

Since its foundation in 2013, the company has acquired various patents for the bar game device and play methods and the smart device and methods for jewelry display. As a promising startup, it received the gold award at the 2nd Smart Product Business Competition, held by the Ministry of Science, ICT, and Future Planning. It is actively conducting marketing projects, launching the “Kong” project on Kickstarter, a home game device for the U.S. that uses the company’s contactless moving of things technology.

MTCC prepared the joint pavilion at this exhibition and supported related domestic companies’ participation in CES 2016, promoting the smart venture school Kyungpook National University. It is mainly focused on the competitiveness reinforcement business of new mobile convergence in the global market.

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), CES 2016 is the world's largest exhibition to see the latest global trends in electronics and IT industry in one spot.

AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES for 11 years to introduce the new technologies and products. After the local coverage and research, AVING News will hold 'CES 2016 Review Conference' in AVING Studio, Korea on January 28th.
